intro.fr: The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky the 3rd se joue en multiworld Archipelago depuis 2025.
intro.en: The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky the 3rd has been playable in an Archipelago multiworld since 2025.

text.fr: Nihon Falcom sort The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky the 3rd en 2007.
text.en: Nihon Falcom releases The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky the 3rd in 2007.

text.fr: L'équipe Archipelago-Trails-in-the-Sky-the-3rd publie le 8 mars 2025 l'alpha 0.0.1. Le mod passe par les outils LB-ARK et Factoria de la communauté Aureole-Suite.
text.en: The Archipelago-Trails-in-the-Sky-the-3rd team releases alpha 0.0.1 on March 8, 2025. The mod relies on the Aureole-Suite community's LB-ARK and Factoria tools.

text.fr: La version 0.1.7 sort le 4 mai 2026 ; c'est la plus récente au 23 octobre 2026 (10 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 0.1.7 is released on May 4, 2026; it is the latest as of October 23, 2026 (10 versions released).
